text: Read all of index.mjs (3651 lines) and schema.mjs (161) before writing a comment; the class AiRuns is the interface (about 45 public members), almost every answer is an ad-hoc object built from SQL rows, so the checker sees them as any and cannot verify the kinds I state against the code. The listing also lists every private #member of the class as an entry (about 60 of them).

False start: I wrote the answers as exact unions (started/refused, found/not found). The source then checked, but the module's own tests read fields without narrowing (r.code on an answer they know refused), drawing about 150 new 'comment disagrees with tests' refusals. Rewriting each multi-shape answer as one kind with optional members, which is how the code and its readers treat them. Also found: a @bound line placed between @property lines ends the typedef in TypeScript's reader, silently dropping every later member (TickDone.ended, DispatchOutcome.status, WorkProduct.registered); bounds must come after all members.

Placed @bound lines between @property lines; TypeScript's reader ends a typedef at the first unknown tag, silently dropping later members (TickDone.ended, DispatchOutcome.status, WorkProduct.registered); moved every @bound after the members
Put read's @param/@returns into a /* */ comment (not JSDoc) above it; they were not read
corrections: Literal kinds widened where the code builds the value in an un-annotated local or closure (started, ok, DispatchOutcome.state, segment_end.next, WorkProduct.lens.basis, LensAtOpen.unreadable): TypeScript widens them and the check refused the literal
Two local closures given a @type comment (open's and listInContext's refusal builders) and one local (tickAndContinue's dispatch) a @type, so their literals keep their kinds

Typing public parameters made private helpers that default a parameter to null infer the kind null, so I had to add @param to four private helpers (#aiRunProjectGate, #aiRunTerminate, #standardForRun, #shed) and drop the @returns of #aiRunDispatch
Echoed run ids typed string | undefined (the request's run is optional because every method defaults its argument to {})
OpenManyRequest.owner widened to * because the code's own inference of #accountFor's answer refused string | null
Added ai-use's refusal extras to OpenAnswer and TickAnswer after tests read them
notes: Check before: 327 refused (140 code, 174 tests, 13 form). After: 387 = 74 code, 256 tests, 13 form, 44 bound-test (d). Against the real state: 75 earlier refusals gone (the reader now knows the answers' shapes), 91 new besides (d): 61 'Object is possibly null' where a test reads runFor/read/boundOf/partAdmitted without a null check (the kind is honestly nullable), about 27 where a test deliberately passes a wrong kind to prove a refusal (usage: 'x', viewer: 7, a credential field) or reads an optional field directly (note, detail), and 3 pre-existing refusals whose text changed. Listing 'anything' lines: 159 before, 202 after; after, 94 are on private #members (listed as entries but unreachable by users) and 108 on public entries, every one a * I wrote for another module's kind or an opaque value, or the class entry writing out its private members. Wall time is by the clock; sourceLinesRead counts index.mjs 3651 + schema.mjs 161 + run-rules and the tool's listing/check code skimmed (about 160).
